name: @stewardmd/capacitor-prep-widgets
description: PrepNucleus home widgets and Live Activity bridge. setData writes the readiness snapshot to the App Group (iOS WidgetKit) or SharedPreferences (Android AppWidget) and refreshes the widgets; startActivity/updateActivity/endActivity drive the iOS 16.2+ Live Activity. Exposed to JS as Capacitor.Plugins.PrepWidgets.
author: StewardMD
